<export xmlns="http://de.fhg.iais.roberta.blockly">
    <program>
        <block_set xmlns="http://de.fhg.iais.roberta.blockly" robottype="edison" xmlversion="3.1" description="" tags="">
            <instance x="20" y="20">
                <block type="robControls_start" id="pt01" intask="true" deletable="false">
                    <mutation declare="true"/>
                    <field name="DEBUG">FALSE</field>
                    <statement name="ST">
                        <block type="robGlobalVariables_declare" id="pt03" intask="true" deletable="false" movable="false">
                            <mutation next="false" declaration_type="Number"/>
                            <field name="VAR">sides</field>
                            <field name="TYPE">Number</field>
                            <value name="VALUE">
                                <block type="math_number" id="pt02" intask="true">
                                    <field name="NUM">0</field>
                                </block>
                            </value>
                        </block>
                    </statement>
                </block>
                <block type="actions_led_edison" id="pt10" intask="true">
                    <field name="ACTORPORT">LLED</field>
                    <field name="MODE">ON</field>
                </block>
                <block type="robActions_motorDiff_on" id="pt11" intask="true">
                    <field name="DIRECTION">FOREWARD</field>
                    <value name="POWER">
                        <block type="math_number" id="pt12" intask="true">
                            <field name="NUM">50</field>
                        </block>
                    </value>
                </block>
                <block type="robControls_wait_for" id="pt13" intask="true">
                    <value name="WAIT0">
                        <block type="logic_compare" id="pt14" intask="true">
                            <field name="OP">EQ</field>
                            <value name="A">
                                <block type="robSensors_getSample" id="pt15" intask="true">
                                    <mutation input="INFRARED_OBSTACLE"/>
                                    <field name="SENSORTYPE">INFRARED_OBSTACLE</field>
                                    <field name="SENSORPORT">FRONT</field>
                                    <field name="SLOT"/>
                                </block>
                            </value>
                            <value name="B">
                                <block type="logic_boolean" id="pt16" intask="true">
                                    <field name="BOOL">TRUE</field>
                                </block>
                            </value>
                        </block>
                    </value>
                </block>
                <block type="robActions_motorDiff_stop" id="pt17" intask="true"/>
                <block type="actions_led_edison" id="pt18" intask="true">
                    <field name="ACTORPORT">LLED</field>
                    <field name="MODE">OFF</field>
                </block>
                <block type="robActions_play_tone" id="pt19" intask="true">
                    <value name="FREQUENCE">
                        <block type="math_number" id="pt20" intask="true">
                            <field name="NUM">440</field>
                        </block>
                    </value>
                    <value name="DURATION">
                        <block type="math_number" id="pt21" intask="true">
                            <field name="NUM">200</field>
                        </block>
                    </value>
                </block>
                <block type="robProcedures_callnoreturn" id="pt22" intask="true">
                    <mutation name="square">
                        <arg name="side" type="Number"/>
                    </mutation>
                    <value name="ARG0">
                        <block type="math_number" id="pt23" intask="true">
                            <field name="NUM">20</field>
                        </block>
                    </value>
                </block>
                <block type="robActions_motor_on" id="pt24" intask="true">
                    <field name="MOTORPORT">LMOTOR</field>
                    <value name="POWER">
                        <block type="math_number" id="pt25" intask="true">
                            <field name="NUM">30</field>
                        </block>
                    </value>
                </block>
                <block type="robControls_wait_time" id="pt26" intask="true">
                    <value name="WAIT">
                        <block type="math_number" id="pt27" intask="true">
                            <field name="NUM">1000</field>
                        </block>
                    </value>
                </block>
                <block type="robActions_motor_stop" id="pt28" intask="true">
                    <field name="MOTORPORT">LMOTOR</field>
                </block>
            </instance>
            <instance x="500" y="20">
                <block type="robProcedures_defnoreturn" id="pt40" intask="true">
                    <mutation declare="true"/>
                    <field name="NAME">square</field>
                    <statement name="ST">
                        <block type="robLocalVariables_declare" id="pt41" intask="true" deletable="false" movable="false">
                            <mutation next="false" declaration_type="Number"/>
                            <field name="VAR">side</field>
                            <field name="TYPE">Number</field>
                        </block>
                    </statement>
                    <statement name="STACK">
                        <block type="controls_repeat_ext" id="pt42" intask="true">
                            <value name="TIMES">
                                <block type="math_number" id="pt43" intask="true">
                                    <field name="NUM">4</field>
                                </block>
                            </value>
                            <statement name="DO">
                                <block type="robActions_motorDiff_on_for" id="pt44" intask="true">
                                    <field name="DIRECTION">FOREWARD</field>
                                    <value name="POWER">
                                        <block type="math_number" id="pt45" intask="true">
                                            <field name="NUM">50</field>
                                        </block>
                                    </value>
                                    <value name="DISTANCE">
                                        <block type="variables_get" id="pt46" intask="true">
                                            <mutation datatype="Number"/>
                                            <field name="VAR">side</field>
                                        </block>
                                    </value>
                                </block>
                                <block type="robActions_motorDiff_turn_for" id="pt47" intask="true">
                                    <field name="DIRECTION">RIGHT</field>
                                    <value name="POWER">
                                        <block type="math_number" id="pt48" intask="true">
                                            <field name="NUM">50</field>
                                        </block>
                                    </value>
                                    <value name="DEGREE">
                                        <block type="math_number" id="pt49" intask="true">
                                            <field name="NUM">90</field>
                                        </block>
                                    </value>
                                </block>
                                <block type="robMath_change" id="pt50" intask="true">
                                    <value name="VAR">
                                        <block type="variables_get" id="pt51" intask="true">
                                            <mutation datatype="Number"/>
                                            <field name="VAR">sides</field>
                                        </block>
                                    </value>
                                    <value name="DELTA">
                                        <block type="math_number" id="pt52" intask="true">
                                            <field name="NUM">1</field>
                                        </block>
                                    </value>
                                </block>
                            </statement>
                        </block>
                    </statement>
                </block>
            </instance>
            <instance x="500" y="400">
                <block type="robProcedures_defnoreturn" id="pt60" intask="true">
                    <mutation declare="true"/>
                    <field name="NAME">blink</field>
                    <statement name="ST">
                        <block type="robLocalVariables_declare" id="pt61" intask="true" deletable="false" movable="false">
                            <mutation next="false" declaration_type="Number"/>
                            <field name="VAR">times</field>
                            <field name="TYPE">Number</field>
                        </block>
                    </statement>
                    <statement name="STACK">
                        <block type="controls_repeat_ext" id="pt62" intask="true">
                            <value name="TIMES">
                                <block type="variables_get" id="pt63" intask="true">
                                    <mutation datatype="Number"/>
                                    <field name="VAR">times</field>
                                </block>
                            </value>
                            <statement name="DO">
                                <block type="actions_led_edison" id="pt64" intask="true">
                                    <field name="ACTORPORT">LLED</field>
                                    <field name="MODE">ON</field>
                                </block>
                                <block type="robControls_wait_time" id="pt65" intask="true">
                                    <value name="WAIT">
                                        <block type="math_number" id="pt66" intask="true">
                                            <field name="NUM">200</field>
                                        </block>
                                    </value>
                                </block>
                                <block type="actions_led_edison" id="pt67" intask="true">
                                    <field name="ACTORPORT">LLED</field>
                                    <field name="MODE">OFF</field>
                                </block>
                                <block type="robControls_wait_time" id="pt68" intask="true">
                                    <value name="WAIT">
                                        <block type="math_number" id="pt69" intask="true">
                                            <field name="NUM">200</field>
                                        </block>
                                    </value>
                                </block>
                            </statement>
                        </block>
                    </statement>
                </block>
            </instance>
            <instance x="500" y="700">
                <block type="robProcedures_defnoreturn" id="pt80" intask="true">
                    <mutation declare="false"/>
                    <field name="NAME">curveLeft</field>
                    <statement name="STACK">
                        <block type="robActions_motorDiff_curve_for" id="pt81" intask="true">
                            <field name="DIRECTION">FOREWARD</field>
                            <value name="POWER_LEFT">
                                <block type="math_number" id="pt82" intask="true">
                                    <field name="NUM">30</field>
                                </block>
                            </value>
                            <value name="POWER_RIGHT">
                                <block type="math_number" id="pt83" intask="true">
                                    <field name="NUM">60</field>
                                </block>
                            </value>
                            <value name="DISTANCE">
                                <block type="math_number" id="pt84" intask="true">
                                    <field name="NUM">20</field>
                                </block>
                            </value>
                        </block>
                    </statement>
                </block>
            </instance>
        </block_set>
    </program>
    <config>
        <block_set xmlns="http://de.fhg.iais.roberta.blockly" robottype="edison" xmlversion="3.1" description="" tags="">
            <instance x="213" y="213">
                <block type="robBrick_Edison-Brick" id="1" intask="true" deletable="false"/>
            </instance>
        </block_set>
    </config>
</export>
